assignment: Recommend a first digitization batch and document how it reflects the archive's priorities.
source: There are 12 staff-days. Group A contains six fragile maps needing two days each, with one request per year. Group B contains eight frequently requested ledgers needing one day each, with 40 requests yearly. Group C contains four community-language pamphlets needing one day each. C has low recorded use but no searchable catalog entry. Only two map supports are available this month.

criteria.full: Provides a batch within 12 staff-days and at most two maps, showing the arithmetic.
criteria.partial: Gives priorities without checking days and map supports.

criteria.full: Weighs preservation, access demand and discovery bias for the uncataloged pamphlets.
criteria.partial: Uses historical request volume as the sole proxy for value.

criteria.full: Explains a credible alternative batch and what it would displace.
criteria.partial: Lists alternatives without articulating opportunity cost.

criteria.full: Specifies logging condition and usage after description, plus a decision point for the next batch.
